description: This file defines the `HtmlDumper` class in the Twig library's Profiler Dumper component. It is responsible for formatting and dumping profiling data related to Twig templates into HTML, including color-coded and styled output for various profile types and durations.

classes.name: Twig\Profiler\Dumper\HtmlDumper
classes.description: A class that extends BaseDumper and provides HTML-formatted profiling output for Twig templates, with color coding for different profile types.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Generates an HTML string that contains the dumped profile information enclosed in a <pre> tag.

methods.name: formatTemplate
methods.description: Formats the profile data for templates with a specific style and background color.

methods.name: formatNonTemplate
methods.description: Formats profile data for non-template items, including the type and name, with styled output.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats the duration and percentage time of profile entries, styling the output based on threshold values.
